text_normalization: Unicode NFC, trim, collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space, UTF-8 SHA-256
verification_policy: Source binding identifies normative text only. It does not verify implementation, runtime, production or real-world behavior.

requirements.requirement_text: La implementación MUST tratar este documento como composition contract y MUST NOT convertirlo en un nuevo runtime monolítico.
Toda ejecución MUST cargar las versiones exactas de las tres specs hijas declaradas en el Composition Manifest.
Una copia de una spec con hash distinto MUST considerarse una versión distinta y requiere reconciliation antes de continuar.
Ningún resumen, conversación, ticket, prompt o memoria del agente sustituye el texto hash-bound de una spec.
El Requirement Ledger MUST conservar el origen exacto de cada requisito y nunca atribuirlo solo a “la master spec”.
El Composition Manifest MUST enumerar `spec_id`, versión, hash, fecha, scope y status de cada spec.
El cierre MUST fallar si falta una spec incorporada, su hash no coincide o no puede leerse completa.
La supersession MUST nombrar requisito origen, motivo, resolución, approvers, fecha y migration impact.
Una supersession root MAY resolver composición, pero MUST NOT debilitar ley, tenant isolation, autoridad, financial truth, Verified Savings o data rights.
Antes de implementar, el ejecutor MUST registrar el ZIP/commit/source-tree exacto realmente usado.
La evidencia histórica de build/test MUST etiquetarse como histórica y MUST NOT presentarse como rerun actual.
La discrepancia documental 2.249/2.251, cuando aparezca en artifacts del repo, MUST reconciliarse y no resolverse escogiendo el número favorable.
El runtime remoto, datos reales, secrets, provider accounts y producción MUST permanecer `UNKNOWN` hasta evidencia autenticada.
El verdict `NOT_GO_READY` prevalece hasta una nueva release evidence pack completa; este documento no lo revoca.
The staged-tree mismatch MUST remain an open parity defect until the build/deploy provenance identifies the authoritative artifact; neither hash may be selected by convenience.
Todo campo no verificado MUST conservar `UNKNOWN` y nunca convertirse en `false`, `zero`, `not applicable` o `pass`.
El implementador MUST producir un Runtime Parity Report antes de cambiar `verification_level` a `RUNTIME_VERIFIED`.
Un cambio material MUST NOT reescribir evidence packs o manifests ya emitidos.
Toda versión histórica MUST seguir siendo interpretable con su schema y compatibility mapping originales.
Los keywords normativos se aplican a requisitos root y a todos los requisitos hijos incorporados.
Un ejemplo, schema ilustrativo o diagrama MUST NOT interpretarse como autorización de implementación ni evidencia de existencia.
“Eventually”, “target”, “should become” o tiempo futuro MUST conservar status `TARGET`.
Un nombre de entidad, test, pantalla, feature flag o comment MUST NOT probar runtime, semantics, data quality ni readiness.
Planning, auditing y contract design MUST quedar separados de operaciones externas o irreversibles.
Cada acción material requiere la authority existente aplicable además de cualquier confidence/model score.
Ninguna integración MUST describirse como complete, production-ready, self-learning o proprietary-model-ready bajo la evidencia auditada.
La current reality MUST reauditarse ante un repo, schema o runtime distinto.
Cada reuse MUST resolver a code/schema refs del source exacto antes de cambios.
Un recurso existente MUST mantenerse como authoritative base hasta que un ADR y migration evidence autoricen otra cosa.
`PARTIAL` MUST conservar una lista explícita de comportamiento y evidence faltantes.
`PARTIAL` MUST NOT traducirse como “nearly done”.
Los nombres físicos de recursos `TARGET` MUST decidirse solo después de inventory/ADR.
Un schema `TARGET` MUST NOT aparecer en Admin como current capability.
Ninguna de estas contradicciones MAY alimentar una training row, calibrated claim o material action antes de remediation.
Toda corrección MUST preservar los valores históricos originales y producir supersession/migration evidence.
Estos estados no cambian por la creación de este documento.
Un seal hijo `ISSUED` no se infiere; debe resolverse a su attestation activa y evidence bundle.
Toda decisión material MUST ser reconstruible desde evidence hasta outcome.
Todo training row MUST ser reconstruible hasta una experiencia elegible.
Todo model output MUST declarar model/deployment, support, time, purpose y authority eligibility.
Todo domain system MUST conservar su operational truth y publicar adapters, no duplicar truth.
El sistema MUST poder abstenerse, corregir, revocar, borrar cuando proceda, reconciliar y rollback.
Ninguna flecha MUST inferirse por confidence, proximity temporal o UI state.
El full loop MUST soportar partial execution, failure, cancellation, dispute, expiry y unattributable outcomes.
Ningún critical handoff MAY depender exclusivamente de natural-language history.
Un prompt MUST NOT ser tratado como runtime API, event bus o durable memory.
Una tecnología nueva MUST justificarse por requirement, scale, control o evidence, no por moda.
La composición MUST preferir adapters/views a nuevas sources of truth.
La primera implementación MAY ser modular dentro del monorepo y MUST conservar ownership boundaries.
No se requiere un learned model para declarar un contract profile implementado; sí para cualquier model-ready claim.
Operational truth precedes learning.
Deterministic no significa verified.
Missing no significa zero, false, failure ni negative label.
Evidence, observation, claim, inference, scenario, prediction, causal estimate y verified outcome son clases distintas.
Point-in-time correctness es obligatoria.
Toda derivación material conserva provenance y semantic version.
Recommendation no es execution.
Execution no es outcome.
Outcome observado no es causal effect.
Model agreement no es ground truth.
Un human override no es label salvo independent outcome contract.
Baseline first.
Models recommend; policy evaluates; authority authorizes; domain executor acts.
Confidence never expands authority.
Material uncertainty in identity, tenant, evidence, policy, cost or approval fails closed.
A model cannot verify its own outcome or approve its own promotion.
One semantic owner per shared contract.
Logical capability does not imply physical service/entity.
Extend before replace.
Append/version/supersede before destructive mutation.
At-least-once delivery requires idempotent consumers.
Exactly-once MUST NOT be claimed without executable evidence.
Privacy classification propagates to derivatives.
Tenant filtering after global retrieval is insufficient.
Purpose and data rights are independent from technical availability.
Every paid action has estimate, reservation, execution receipt and reconciliation.
Cost reduction never justifies weaker privacy or authority.
Every seal expires or has a mandatory review time.
Memory is not training.
RAG is not training.
Calibration is not causal learning.
A prompt or external LLM is not a CAMBRA-trained proprietary model.
Prediction never becomes billing truth.
Un source/runtime mismatch MUST abrir defect y bloquear seals afectados.
Root MUST NOT sobrescribir domain semantics fuera de las clauses explícitamente reconciliadas.
CPIC MAY imponer controles estadísticos más estrictos sin crear un segundo sistema padre.
ALIF MAY imponer límites de contact/suppression más estrictos sin debilitar shared authority.
Un conflicto incompatible MUST tener estado `BLOCKED` en Requirement Ledger.
Su resolución requiere owners de ambos contratos, privacy/security/authority reviewers según riesgo y migration plan.
Estas supersessions MUST registrarse en Compatibility Ledger con exact anchors.
Cada Capability Status record MUST incluir implementation y verification como ejes separados.
`IMPLEMENTED` en progress MUST NOT mapear automáticamente a `EXISTING` o `TEST_VERIFIED`.
`EXISTING + SOURCE_OBSERVED` MUST ser una combinación válida.
Un test PASS MUST quedar ligado a source/config/data/environment hashes.
`NOT_APPLICABLE` requiere rationale factual, evidence y reviewer independiente.
`NOT_PRESENT` MUST cite the inspected baseline; it MUST NOT be used as a synonym for an unverified absence.
`BLOCKED` test status MUST name the dependency/blocker, owner and next evidence; it blocks every dependent seal.
`EXPERIMENTAL` MUST usarse como release/exposure qualifier, no implementation status.
Un legacy `stage` que mezcle artifact/deployment/role MUST convertirse en compatibility projection.
Product copy MUST derivar de claim_mode, support, verification, time y active seal.
Antes de crear un recurso, el implementador MUST buscar repo, specs, schemas, functions, shared modules y consumers.
La creación `NEW` requiere ADR que pruebe por qué `EXTEND` no basta.
Dos nombres con semántica equivalente MUST mapearse mediante alias, no implementarse automáticamente como dos recursos.
Root MUST publish this map as machine-readable `SharedContractRegistry`.
Owner changes require migration, consumer inventory, dual-read plan where needed and seal impact.
A steward MAY strengthen its profile but MUST NOT redefine base keys or lifecycle unilaterally.
Duplicate candidates MUST be merged, adapted, deprecated or justified before closure.
“Temporary” duplicates MUST have owner, expiry, divergence monitor and removal gate.
`REUSE` is permitted only after semantic and tenant/time ownership match is proven.
Extensions SHOULD be additive first.
Defaults MUST preserve unknown semantics; no economic field defaults to zero.
Migration MUST be dry-run, idempotent, restartable, observable and rollback-capable.
Historical unknowns MUST remain unknown.
New `AgentRun` writes MUST stop only after all producers/consumers are mapped, WorkflowAttempt compatibility passes and rollback is proven.
`Event` payload/history MUST remain immutable; retries, claims and delivery status belong to a delivery projection/receipt.
Legacy operational incidents MUST resolve through an adapter to one canonical incident lifecycle without losing source evidence.
This list MUST NOT be used as an instruction to add one Base44 entity per noun.
A logical contract MAY be implemented as fields, artifacts, views or existing entities if invariants hold.
Deprecation MUST preserve historical rendering and interpretation.
A deprecated writer MUST reject new use after cutover while readers remain through the compatibility window.
`requirement_uid` MUST incluir spec/version y no depender de un local ID globalmente único.
Closure reports MUST generarse desde el ledger, no desde memoria del implementador.
Un requisito `VERIFIED` MUST tener executable test/runtime evidence proporcional al riesgo.
Toda incompatibilidad conocida MUST aparecer aunque la implementación aún no exista.
“Same meaning” MUST probarse con fixtures, no por nombre parecido.
Alias resolution MUST be deterministic, versioned and visible in Admin/developer contracts.
Los 22 IDs colisionados MUST conservar resultados separados.
Renaming for display MUST retain immutable legacy alias.
Todo integration evidence pack MUST pin un `composition_id`.
Cambiar una spec, repo, shared contract o alias map material MUST crear nueva composition version.
Cada cross-domain reference MUST ser un typed ref con canonical ID, identity version y tenant/scope.
Un external provider ID MUST ser alias, nunca canonical ID por defecto.
`OutboundLead` MUST conservarse como candidate snapshot y MUST NOT auto-convertirse en merchant/brand.
Company identity y candidacy MUST permanecer separadas.
Selected Contact MUST ser strategy/time-specific y no “best contact forever”.
Un ref con `AMBIGUOUS` o `QUARANTINED` MUST NOT autorizar cross-thread memory, training, spend o external contact.
Point-in-time resolution MUST use the identity map available at the relevant decision time.
P3, P4, P5, Analyzer, Adaptive y Negotiation MUST resolver el mismo provider reference para el mismo objeto/periodo.
Alias de provider con periodos incompatibles MUST NOT join silenciosamente.
Name-only matching MUST NOT auto-merge across jurisdictions.
Verified domain MAY support a match but conflicts MUST quarantine.
Corporate group leakage MUST control dataset splits where material.
Wrong-company contact risk MUST fail closed.
Contact point verification and employer relation MUST have independent statuses.
Suppression MUST follow the person/contact point across compatible aliases as policy requires.
Merge MUST NOT erase source IDs or rewrite sealed datasets.
A later merge/split MUST create contamination/impact reports for existing datasets/models.
Tombstoned identities MUST NOT be silently recreated by enrichment.
Every committed experience, memory, prediction, task and cost receipt MUST carry explicit scope.
Caller-supplied tenant, brand or scope MUST NOT expand authenticated server scope.
Service-role execution MUST bind tenant and purpose explicitly.
Cross-tenant aggregation MUST pass contribution, dominance, minimum cohort and anti-differencing policy.
Availability for service delivery MUST NOT imply permission for training, shadow or global aggregate.
Derived data MUST retain purpose and access restrictions from inputs unless an approved transformation proves otherwise.
Application-side filtering after a global read MUST NOT be the only tenant boundary.
Cache, index, vector, prompt, logs, export and Admin MUST enforce the same scope.
Adapters MUST preserve all known times and MUST NOT collapse them by convenience.
Feature values MUST satisfy `available_at <= prediction_time`.
Backfills MUST preserve real availability when known and MUST NOT invent historical availability.
Late events MUST be accepted through supersession/recalculation policy.
Storage timestamps MUST use UTC; business calendars/time zones MUST be explicit.
A sequence gap MUST be detected and reconciled.
Out-of-order delivery MUST NOT silently regress authoritative state.
Currency unknown MUST fail closed for a material calculation.
Percent, decimal, basis points and flat fees MUST have explicit units.
Cross-currency aggregation MUST pin FX source/time and preserve native amounts.
Estimated, reserved, authorized, settled, invoiced, paid and reconciled amounts MUST remain distinct.
Report rounding MUST be separate from computational precision.
No domain MAY create an incompatible event bus or experience ledger.
Operational source records remain authoritative for domain state.
`experience_id` and idempotency key MUST be CAMBRA-owned and stable across retry.
Raw content MAY remain in its source; event MUST preserve pointer, hash, purpose and access.
Every event type MUST resolve an approved schema profile.
A failed source mutation MUST NOT emit a committed success experience.
Same idempotency key + same semantic payload yields one logical event.
Same key + different semantic payload MUST conflict and alert.
Correction MUST supersede; it MUST NOT mutate immutable history silently.
Adapter mapping MUST NOT grant authority to a model/rule/provider actor.
Event consumer inventory MUST be maintained before a breaking change.
An event name MUST NOT imply successful execution unless an execution receipt exists.
`training_use_permitted=true` MUST NOT make an experience eligible without the independent eligibility receipt.
ALIF profile MUST validate as an additive Universal Experience profile.
`tenant_id` MUST NOT remain nullable in committed Adaptive events.
Candidate state projection MUST be rebuildable from accepted events or explicitly labelled snapshot-only legacy.
A CPIC bare float MUST NOT be a servable material prediction.
Prediction receipt MUST NOT double as evidence, outcome or label.
OOD/abstention MUST remain an observable valid result, distinct from malformed failure.
Analyzer profile MUST distinguish verified facts, inferred values, scenarios and outcomes.
Exact wording remains in authorized source; derived episode events carry bounded refs/extractions.
Proposed, accepted, signed, executed and realized MUST never collapse.
A risk estimate MUST NOT transition migration state.
Estimated savings and Verified Savings MUST use distinct event/claim modes.
A source reference alone MUST NOT become a verified claim.
Evidence validation MUST check existence, tenant, subject, semantics, time, integrity and access.
Caller-supplied evidence ID count MUST NOT satisfy corroboration.
Copied sources sharing one upstream MUST count as one source family where dependence matters.
P12 dedupe MUST include tenant and semantic subject boundary.
P4 observations MUST bind server-resolved tenant/brand/subject context.
A new current observation MUST supersede prior current projection deterministically.
`DETERMINISTIC` MUST NOT imply `VERIFIED`.
`CALIBRATED_IN_SCOPE` requires empirical evidence for named population/window/version.
`CAUSAL_IN_SCOPE` requires active CPIC causal seal for exact estimand.
Dispute MUST block unqualified realization/billing claims.
UI/API/export MUST preserve claim mode and limitations.
Fallback MUST never retain a stronger semantic label than its method supports.
No record MUST imply its successor solely from status proximity.
A model decision and a business policy decision MUST remain distinct.
Material decisions MUST include do-nothing/abstain where valid.
Decision context MUST be immutable and point-in-time.
A model MUST NOT remove an action constraint.
Policy version MUST be persisted on decision/action receipts.
Authority MUST be server-enforced at execution time.
UI state MUST NOT grant authority.
Material input/term change MUST invalidate approval.
Concurrent approvals MUST resolve deterministically; stale approval MUST not win.
Approval replay MUST NOT duplicate side effect.
“Sent”, “signed”, “migrated” or “paid” requires external/domain receipt, not task completion alone.
Execution worker MUST revalidate authority, tenant, policy and approval after dequeue.
Unobserved outcome MUST NOT become negative.
Immature outcome MUST remain pending/censored.
Outcome writer MUST validate linked execution where label semantics require action.
Outcome correction MUST trigger downstream eligibility/dataset/model impact.
No giant “super orchestrator” MAY duplicate domain logic.
Existing workers/schedulers MUST be inventoried before a new physical orchestrator is proposed.
New workflow contracts MUST adapt/extend these resources where semantically adequate.
Existing IDs, audit and consumers MUST survive migration.
Logical types MUST NOT imply five new physical Base44 entities.
Definition version MUST be immutable once used by an instance.
Instance MUST pin definition and policy versions.
Step side-effect class MUST determine approval, retry and compensation requirements.
Attempt history MUST be append-only.
Handoff acceptance MUST be explicit; natural-language delivery is insufficient.
Terminal workflow state MUST be server-enforced.
A completed workflow MUST not be mutated; correction/compensation creates linked records.
Partial completion MUST enumerate committed steps and pending/failed effects.
Parent workflow `COMPLETED` requires every mandatory step `COMPLETED` or explicitly policy-skipped with a receipt.
`EXECUTION_UNKNOWN` MUST block blind retry until external/domain receipt reconciliation resolves effect status.
Mapping MUST be evidence-based per subtype; no blanket conversion.
An `AgentRun SUCCEEDED` MUST NOT imply domain action executed without receipt.
Scheduler claim and domain execution MUST use separate idempotency boundaries.
Target-state implementations MUST create no new `AgentRun` writer after the approved cutover; residual reads use the compatibility adapter.
Each handoff MUST reject ambiguous identity, missing tenant, stale approval or incompatible schema.
Handoff retry MUST not duplicate downstream side effects.
Producers and consumers MUST tolerate duplicate delivery.
“Exactly once” MUST NOT appear in product/architecture claims without proven end-to-end effect semantics.
A success experience MUST not exist for uncommitted domain state.
If Base44 transaction semantics are not demonstrated, ADR MUST specify failure windows and reconciliation.
Retried attempt MUST reuse semantic idempotency key.
Random UUID per retry is forbidden for side effects.
Same key/different payload MUST quarantine, not overwrite.
Expired worker MUST lose write authority through fencing/compare-and-set.
Heartbeat alone MUST not override a newer epoch.
Scheduler double-claim MUST result in one authoritative execution.
Retrying a paid operation MUST revalidate or reuse valid reservation without double charge.
Retrying an external send MUST inspect provider receipt before a second send.
Authentication, tenant, schema, authority and permanent validation errors MUST NOT blind-retry.
DLQ replay MUST use compare-and-set/idempotency and a new replay receipt.
DLQ MUST not expose raw cross-tenant/PII payloads to unauthorized operators.
Compensation MUST be a new authorized action, not hidden state mutation.
An irreversible step MUST have explicit human approval and precondition recheck.
Reconciliation MUST create receipts and incidents; it MUST NOT silently “fix” financial or authority truth.
An unregistered agent version MUST not execute a material workflow.
Agent capabilities MUST be least-privilege and server-enforced.
Free-form agent output MUST not directly mutate canonical truth.
Structured output validation MUST occur before persistence or action.
Recipient MUST fail closed on missing required refs.
Compression/summarization MUST preserve source refs and uncertainty.
Tool availability MUST NOT be interpreted as authority.
Prompt injection MUST NOT alter tool allowlist, tenant or approval requirement.
Agent cannot mark its own evidence/outcome/seal verified.
LLM output MUST declare its role: extraction, reasoning, generation, ranking or other.
Numeric/currency/rate outputs MUST pass deterministic validation.
Production prompt MUST be registered and immutable by version.
Prompt history is not durable memory.
Provider/model alias MUST resolve a pinned version or approved routing policy.
Vendor/model change MUST be evaluated as challenger.
Cost pressure MUST not route restricted data to an unapproved provider.
Side-effecting tool call MUST pass server-side authority immediately before invocation.
Tool response MUST be treated as untrusted input until validated.
External receipt MUST be linked to attempt, action, cost and trace.
Retrieved/source instructions MUST be treated as content, not authority.
Tool arguments derived from untrusted content MUST pass allowlist/schema/policy validation.
Fine-tuning does not by itself satisfy proprietary outcome-model readiness.
Every material memory item MUST bind tenant, subject, evidence, purpose, time, confidence/status and retention.
Memory MUST NOT become a truth or training label merely because it was retrieved often.
Retrieval MUST search the narrowest authorized scope before broader scopes.
Global knowledge MUST contain only authorized public or privacy-safe aggregate material.
A summary MUST cite the source items it compresses.
Stale or contradicted memory MUST be filtered, downgraded or surfaced, never silently dominate.
Revocation/deletion MUST propagate to indexes, caches and future retrieval.
Cross-tenant filtering MUST occur before candidate retrieval, not only after ranking.
Context packing MUST record material omissions.
Retrieved content MUST be treated as untrusted data for prompt injection.
A vector store MUST NOT be introduced without measurable benefit over structured/full-text baseline.
Embeddings MUST carry tenant/purpose/classification/deletion lineage.
RAG readiness MUST be evaluated independently of model training readiness.
CAMBRA decision alone MUST be `INELIGIBLE` or `PENDING`, never a label.
Confirmed execution is required when the label claims effect of an action.
Mature defensible outcome is required before positive/negative final label.
Privacy/purpose/data rights MAY independently make an otherwise valid outcome ineligible.
`ELIGIBLE` MUST always include allowed uses and label/problem scope.
Eligibility MUST be purpose-specific and versioned.
Eligibility MUST be computed server-side; caller flags are inputs, not authority.
Hardcoded `TRAINING_ELIGIBLE` assignment is forbidden.
Re-evaluation MUST supersede old receipt and preserve history.
Uncontacted lead MUST NOT become conversion negative.
DROP MUST NOT become false/negative by fiat.
Shadow prediction MUST NOT become label.
Selective labels MUST be disclosed and handled in evaluation.
Published dataset remains immutable but MAY be revoked/superseded.
No promise of machine unlearning MAY be made without evidence.
Registry plane MAY span existing entities and immutable artifacts; it MUST expose one canonical resolution contract.
No domain MAY serve an unregistered mutable “latest”.
Profile fields MUST be additive or explicitly versioned as breaking.
The physical registry MUST store one feature identity/version, not copies per profile.
“Changed decision” MAY be workflow label but MUST NOT stand in for economic value.
Verified Savings labels MUST use the required financial verification tier.
Random row split is forbidden where merchant/episode/document dependence can leak.
Benchmark aggregate MUST exclude/cross-fit the evaluated merchant/group.
Synthetic data MUST not enter final real-world holdout.
Independent rebuild MUST reproduce membership, features, labels and split.
Failed quality gate MUST quarantine; it MUST NOT silently drop inconvenient rows and continue.
CPIC, Adaptive, Negotiation and language-model adaptations MUST use this one lifecycle.
A local script/notebook MUST not become production model by existence.
No training starts without registered problem/decision.
CPIC estimand and product decision MUST be co-approved where both apply.
Same semantic run request MUST be idempotent.
Unavailable upstream snapshot MUST make run non-reproducible/unsealable.
Artifact status MUST not encode traffic assignment.
Deployment MUST pin artifact, calibrator, support detector, schema and policy.
Domain packs MUST use the same evaluation run/evidence format.
Final holdout access MUST be logged and independent.
Metric thresholds MUST be pre-registered before final holdout/shadow/canary.
No aggregate metric MAY hide failed material segment/support guardrails.
Card without artifact and evidence is documentation only.
Roles MUST be namespaced away from provider/campaign/playbook “champion”.
Transitions MUST be server-enforced and append-only.
Shadow output MUST have `eligible_for_learning=false` as a label source.
Shadow failure MUST not affect champion response.
Manual favorable-case cherry-picking is forbidden.
Canary MUST stop immediately on tenant/privacy/authority/critical numerical integrity violation.
A feature flag alone MUST not be promotion authority.
Rollback MUST be tested in target environment before material production.
Drift alert MAY propose retraining but MUST not auto-promote a material model.
Label/estimand semantic change MUST create new problem/dataset lineage.
External LLM/model version drift MUST trigger challenger evaluation or quarantine.
Scheduled retraining MUST not mean scheduled promotion.
Revoked data/model impact MAY force suspension before replacement exists.
CPIC service MUST consume canonical server-built context.
Arbitrary caller context MUST not reach private statistical service.
Bare `probability` or `confidence` MUST not be a material integration response.
p10/p50/p90 MUST derive from a declared distribution; low/base/high scenarios use scenario labels.
Calibrated status MUST match target, population, horizon, fee perimeter and validation window.
P4 data structure existence MUST not imply calibrated/OOD behavior.
P4 external path MUST use existing logical `rateIntelligenceQuery` owner where suitable.
No P4-v2 parallel public route/store MAY bypass controls.
Per-case realized “VOI” MUST not be claimed as causal value without design.
A CPIC high VOI result MUST not itself call a source or reserve spend.
Fallback MUST not inherit calibrated/predictive claim mode.
Malformed/tenant-mismatched/non-finite output MUST be rejected before persistence/display.
ALIF MUST not create a second identity, experience, cost, probability or model lifecycle system.
UI lifecycle MUST not own long-running execution.
Global reservoir rows MUST not be presented as scoped run results without relation evidence.
High-fit count MUST not be called a win.
Pre-contact company score MUST not use acquired person fields.
Zero-credit/bundled person data does not remove privacy/purpose gate.
Contact lookup requires explicit outreach-worthiness and role rationale.
Router MUST be deterministic under same version/context except explicit randomized exploration.
Provider unavailable MUST yield approved fallback or `SOURCE_LIMITED`.
Router MUST not infer provider rights/capabilities from historical success alone.
Evidence MUST be stored once through P12/shared contract.
Field-level usefulness and decision delta MUST be measured separately from provider response.
Reservation MUST not be counted as actual cost.
CRM upsert MUST not itself mean qualified/customer.
Send remains independently authorized and idempotent.
Only contacted/delivered/mature cases MAY support reply/conversion labels under label contract.
Learned research policy requires support/positivity, exploration governance and off-policy diagnostics.
CPIC MUST never overwrite a verified merchant fact.
Inferred input MUST be separately addressable and replaceable by later verified fact.
Provider pricing version/effective time/market/product MUST be pinned.
CPIC achievable rate is not official provider rate.
Product copy MUST not call modeled public price “observed real market”.
Existing deterministic growth quantiles MUST not display calibrated range.
P5 MUST not multiply unsupported probabilities into fake joint probability.
Opportunity prediction MUST not mutate verification or financial truth.
PDF/CSV/API MUST preserve status/uncertainty, not only UI.
Historical report MUST preserve original versions or explicitly issue recomputation receipt.
CPIC cannot send, accept, sign, concede or bind.
Provider and product/plan identity MUST be effective-time correct.
Exact wording retention MUST follow purpose/access/retention.
Tactic success MUST use predictive/associational wording without causal design/seal.
Accepted term is not implemented or realized term.
No reply/offer MUST respect maturity and censoring.
Instrumentation readiness MUST not be called negotiation-model readiness.
CPIC estimate cannot advance, complete or rollback a MigrationTask.
Technical go-live MUST not equal verified savings.
Partial migration MUST enumerate scope and remaining dependencies.
Incomplete open migration MUST not be failure label.
Repeated tasks within migration MUST remain grouped in dataset splits.
Prediction MUST never write, approve or certify Verified Savings.
Estimated savings MUST not trigger invoice.
Billing eligibility MUST require the existing approved financial/contract policy.
Each amount MUST retain unit/currency/period/baseline/evidence/status.
Realized value MUST use a defined counterfactual/baseline policy and disclose limitations.
A model-generated baseline MUST not self-validate its own savings label.
Reversal/dispute MUST trigger eligibility and model-impact review.
Classification MUST propagate to extracts, embeddings, summaries, features, logs and artifacts.
Pseudonymization MUST not be described as anonymization.
“Useful for AI” is not a valid purpose.
Vendor capability does not establish lawful use.
Cross-tenant raw rows MUST never enter shared aggregate output.
Identical object IDs across tenants MUST not collide in dedupe/cache/idempotency.
Until resolution, equivalent aggregate releases MUST use the approved safer policy or withhold.
Raw k alone MUST not prove privacy safety.
Every pseudonymized training/aggregate row MUST resolve its key namespace/version.
Rotation MUST not accidentally relink tenants or break required DSAR lookup.
Immutable history MUST support restriction/tombstone without pretending physical erasure where legally retained.
Future dataset builds MUST exclude revoked/restricted records.
Active model impact MUST be assessed and may suspend deployment.
“Unlearned” MUST not be claimed without tested artifact-level evidence.
Bundle receipt MUST not authorize unrestricted storage/use of all person fields.
Discarded contact candidates MUST follow retention/minimization policy.
Provider default settings MUST not override CAMBRA policy.
Threat model MUST map assets, actors, boundaries, mitigations, tests and owners.
Credentials MUST never become feature, memory or evidence content.
Caller/admin-entered “REAL_RUNTIME PASS” metadata is not trusted attestation.
Hash mismatch MUST quarantine deployment/artifact.
Generative output MUST pass content/schema/policy validation before tool use.
Emergency stop MUST be fail-closed, auditable, epoch/fencing-safe and periodically tested.
Stale worker MUST not bypass a new emergency-stop epoch.
No subsystem MAY create a parallel cost authority/ledger.
Paid action MUST not begin without valid reservation.
Cache hit MUST not be billed as fresh provider/model execution.
Retry MUST not bypass cap or double-settle.
Reservation/actual delta MUST be reconciled or flagged unknown.
Hard cap fails closed.
Soft threshold may degrade, defer or warn but not weaken controls.
Cost fallback MUST preserve semantic label honesty.
Proxy value MUST be labelled proxy.
CAMBRA revenue MUST not be treated as merchant utility without explicit stakeholder utility contract.
Every handoff MUST preserve trace/correlation/causation.
Logs MUST use refs/hashes instead of raw sensitive payload by default.
Metric definition MUST include denominator, window, maturity, unit, version and owner.
Model quality metric is not a service SLO; both are required where relevant.
SLO MUST distinguish user-facing and asynchronous paths.
Alert MUST be actionable, owner-routed and linked to runbook.
Sample-insufficient statistical alerts MUST disclose uncertainty, except invariant breaches which alert immediately.
No hidden chain-of-thought is required or stored.
Explanations MUST use reason codes, evidence, sensitivity and limitations.
Restore test MUST validate identities, events, approvals, costs, model pointers and lineage.
Backup existence alone MUST not satisfy recovery evidence.
Legacy `OperationalIncident`/`AutonomyIncident` MUST map to one canonical lifecycle by adapter.
Incident-generated correction MUST not automatically become training label.
P0/P1 incident MUST suspend dependent seals/traffic as policy requires.
Recovery MUST not silently weaken tenant or authority checks.
